keyVerseDR: "For in him we live, and move, and are." (Acts 17:28)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Spirituality
level1.story: Spirituality means living close to God every day. Our life has meaning because God made us and loves us.
level1.keyLine: In God I live and move and am.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice spirituality all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: Where did we feel close to God this week?
How can we make prayer part of every day?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: My God, I believe in You, I hope in You, and I love You. Help me live close to You. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Make the Sign of the Cross when you wake
TUE: Say grace before every meal
WED: Read a short Bible story together
THU: Visit Jesus in a church
FRI: Say a night prayer with your family
SAT: Get ready for Sunday Mass

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Spirituality
level2.story: Spirituality means living by faith in God and knowing that our life has meaning and purpose in Him. As Catholics, we grow close to God through prayer, the Bible, the sacraments, and especially the Mass, where we receive Jesus. Saint Paul says that in God we live and move and have our being. God made each of us for a reason: to know Him, love Him, and serve Him.
level2.keyLine: In God I live and move and am.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice spirituality all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: Where did we feel close to God this week?
How did God help us grow in spirituality?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: My God, I believe in You, I hope in You, and I love You. Help me live close to You. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Pray a decade of the Rosary as a family
TUE: Read and talk about Sunday's Gospel
WED: Make a short visit to the Blessed Sacrament
THU: Learn about your patron saint
FRI: Offer your day to God each morning
SAT: Go to Mass and pay close attention
